content: The execution was successful, confirming that HWPX files (which are OCF-based ZIP archives) can be effectively manipulated by targeting the XML files within the 'Contents/' directory. Key technical success factors were: 1) Using lxml.etree for robust XML handling, 2) Removing <hp:lineSegArray> elements to force the HWP viewer to recalculate layout for the new text, and 3) Ensuring the 'mimetype' file was written first without compression to maintain HWPX format standards. The strategy of merging text from adjacent <hp:t> tags within a paragraph before substitution is essential for HWPX, as placeholders are frequently fragmented by the editor's internal formatting tags.
